charging_law_reference: engine.run_strategy fills: entry b_o+k*s_o / a_o-k*s_o; non-day-close exits at bar-open effective prices; force-flat settles at the CLOSE of the day-close bar; SignalPlane (tracka_lib) semantics: s_open:=a_o-b_o, s_close:=a_c-b_c recomputed from quote columns; day-close = last tradable bar (hour<=19); taker PAYS the spread; k in {1.0 primary, 1.5, 2.0 stress}; cost := net(k1)-net(k0)
ceiling_source: diag/data_local/derived/census_{pair}.json spread_pips.by_session_open conditional p50s (program law: never global p50); non-fragility line = 2x stressed RT (VIABILITY_cohort3_REPORT.md section A frozen council line; AUDUSD/USDCAD stressed RT 3.6/4.4 pips cited as program floor context only)

incidents.desc: first sample recompute reported DEVIATION up to 17.9/14.5 pips (EURUSD/GBPUSD): the recompute read the parquet's stored s_open/s_close columns and used the calendar-last bar as day-close, whereas the committed SignalPlane recomputes spreads as a-b and marks the last TRADABLE bar (hour<=19) as day-close. After matching SignalPlane semantics: max dev ~3e-12 pips, verdict PASS. No attribution-lane artifact was edited; no FINDING against the attribution lane.
